newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Proffitt's brings life to session.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Proffitt's brings life to session.

text.p: Department store Proffitt's Inc was the only stock showing any sign of life during the after-hours session, traders said on Thursday.
"Its the only one that's got anything," said one dealer.
Its stock was trading at 40-1/2 compared to a close of 40-7/8 on the Nasdaq Stock Market earlier in the day.
Proffitt's reported a first-quarter profit of $0.37 a share against $0.35 a year ago.
The company also said it saw as "reasonable" an operating income forecast of $0.26 a share for the second quarter and $0.61 for the third quarter.
"Memorial Day is coming up," said another trader, referring to the long weekend. All markets will be closed on Monday, May 26.
The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday that session one had a volume of 4,400 shares, compared to a higher 9,000 the previous day. Session two had 14.3 million against 1.1 million, it added.
